description: This file defines a Java record class `CategoryResponse` used as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for API responses related to categories in a catalog system. It includes various category attributes like id, merchant store id, code, sort order, visibility, parent category, localized descriptions, creation and update timestamps. Additionally, it contains a nested record `LocalizedText` for localized descriptions, with fields for language id, name, description, and SEO-friendly URL slug.

classes.name: CategoryResponse
classes.description: A record class representing a category response with various category attributes and metadata.

classes.name: LocalizedText
classes.description: A nested record class representing localized text entries with language ID, name, description, and friendly URL.
